scope: Reawaken the project-owned SR10.4 clone, recheck the live normal horizontal scrollbar against its retained VUE image and current GTK2 assets, and verify bounded input cleanup.

wake.initial_image: Black guest framebuffer from a read-only screen:snapshot.
wake.method: One-frame guest-injected :kbd:keyboard4/Shift pulse; automatically released on frame 2, then snapshot at frame 65. This is not a physical host key event.

input_and_cleanup.mouse_motion: Two single measured Apollo relative-counter steps (+1,+1 then -1,0); no button was pressed. The guest pointer was not visibly confirmed over an arrow in the resulting native captures, so no held-arrow test was sent.
input_and_cleanup.cpu_clock_percentages: Not queried in R401; no clock settings were changed.

diagnostic_note: A read-only Lua status query tried field:read(), which this MAME input-field object does not implement; it returned an error without changing input. A follow-up queried the operation object successfully and confirmed the key and mouse callbacks had completed with input released and no cleanup error.
result: The current live VUE horizontal bar is pixel-identical to the retained normal-state sample, and its left/right cells match the installed GTK2 normal assets. This reconfirms normal geometry only. The pointer target was not confirmed, so horizontal press/hold remains unverified; do not infer it from these normal-state pixels.
next: Continue only I167/GTK2. A horizontal held-state comparison requires a current native image that clearly places the guest pointer on the intended arrow; do not send another relative-counter move based on guessed pixel-to-counter mapping.
